login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your NexusPanel workspace

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Live snapshot of your platform
overview.description: This is your home page. Watch real-time CPU, memory, online users and traffic across all nodes. Use it as your daily health check — if anything turns red here, jump to the relevant module to fix it.
overview.noActiveUsersBwHint: No active or online users. Live speeds are not subscription traffic — usually port scans, OS updates, or the panel itself.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage subscriptions and access
users.description: Create and manage everyone who uses your VPN. Each user picks one or more protocols (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks), gets a data limit and an expiry date, and receives a subscription URL. Click a row for a deep-dive with QR codes and one-tap import.
users.wgHint: Keys and peer IP are generated automatically. Download the .conf from user details.
users.revokeSubConfirm: Revoke subscription links? The user must refresh clients.

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.subtitle: Nodes, regions and secure tunnels
infra.description: The physical and logical layer of your network. Nodes are the servers running Xray. Inbounds are the protocols those servers expose. Hosts control the address and TLS your users see. Tunnels relay traffic from an in-country node to a foreign exit.
infra.inboundsDesc: Inbounds define which protocols (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks) your server offers. Add them here — no JSON needed.
infra.inboundRestart: Saving restarts the core (a few seconds of downtime).
infra.hostsDesc: Hosts control the domain, SNI and TLS used in the config links your users get. Use {SERVER_IP} or {USERNAME} as placeholders.
infra.noHost: No host configured — links use the node address.
infra.tunnelDesc: Relay traffic from an in-country node to a foreign exit node.

inbounds.title: Inbounds
inbounds.subtitle: Inbound connections — 3x-ui style
inbounds.description: Protocols and ports your Xray server exposes: VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, HTTP, SOCKS, Mixed, WireGuard, and Tunnel — with full transports (TCP, WS, gRPC, Reality, HTTPUpgrade, SplitHTTP, KCP, QUIC). Users subscribe against these tags.
inbounds.emptyDesc: Add your first inbound — e.g. VLESS + Reality on 443.
inbounds.realityPublicKeyHint: Auto-filled by Generate; share this with clients.
inbounds.fallbackHint: Serve multiple protocols on one port (e.g. VLESS + a web server on 443).
inbounds.fallbackDestHint: Port number or host:port to fall back to
inbounds.proxyAuthHint: Auth is managed via panel users; use advanced JSON for custom accounts.

xray.basicsDesc: Log level and optional access/error log paths.
xray.inboundsDesc: Like 3x-ui: protocol, port, transport, TLS, Reality, and sniffing — no raw JSON.
xray.outboundsDesc: Where traffic exits: DIRECT (freedom), BLOCK (blackhole), proxy chaining (VLESS/VMess/Trojan/SS/SOCKS/HTTP), or WireGuard/WARP.
xray.warpDesc: Paste your registered WARP secretKey, addresses and reserved values. The endpoint and peer public key are pre-filled for Cloudflare WARP.
xray.routingDesc: Rule order matters. Put specific rules above general ones.
xray.outboundTagDisabled: Ignored while a balancer tag is set
xray.balancerTagHint: Route to a balancer defined under routing.balancers (overrides outbound tag).
xray.noRulesHint: No rules yet — e.g. geoip:private → BLOCK
xray.dnsDesc: DNS servers Xray uses for resolution.
xray.dnsAdvancedServersHint: {{count}} advanced server object(s) are kept as-is. Edit them in the Advanced JSON tab.
xray.dnsHostsHint: domain: ip — static overrides. Comma-separate multiple IPs.
xray.jsonDesc: Power users only. Invalid JSON will be rejected on save.
xray.tagPortConflict: Tag or port already in use

resellers.title: Resellers & Brand
resellers.subtitle: White-label tenants and branding
resellers.description: Sell access under your own brand. Each tenant is an isolated reseller with their own users, nodes and quotas. Branding controls the logo, colors and panel title customers see on their subscription page.
resellers.brandingDesc: Customize how your panel and subscription pages look to your customers.

automation.title: Automation
automation.subtitle: Rules, workflows and plugins
automation.description: Make the panel do things on its own. Rules react to events (e.g. notify when a user runs out of data). Workflows chain multiple actions. Plugins extend the panel with integrations like Telegram or webhooks.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Usage trends and traffic intelligence
analytics.description: Understand who is using your network and how. Top users by traffic, heavy hitters that may need a bigger plan, and exhaustion risk for users about to hit their limit — everything you need to grow revenue and spot abuse.
analytics.routingHint: Pick a strategy and load nodes ordered best-first.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Plans, invoices and wallet
billing.description: The commercial layer. Define the plans you sell (data + duration + price), generate invoices, track wallet balances, and review every transaction. Plans link to user templates so a subscription is automatically provisioned on payment.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: Configuration, security and maintenance
system.description: Owner-only controls. Toggle feature flags to enable or disable whole modules, take backups before risky operations, issue API keys for automation, and tweak appearance settings that affect every admin.
system.keyOnceWarning: Copy this key now — it will not be shown again.
system.aboutText: NexusPanel is a modern, multi-tenant control plane for proxy infrastructure.
system.cannotDeleteSudo: Sudo accounts can only be removed via CLI

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.description: Configure your panel title and enable optional modules.
